import json,sys,re
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,"/Users/yong/work/lemmadeck-ws/lemmadeck--STEMROBIN-181/.claude/skills/ld-s10y-lesson/tools")
import edition
lesson=edition.load(Path("/Users/yong/work/lemmadeck-ws/lemmadeck--STEMROBIN-181/.intentfold/tickets/STEMROBIN-181/tmp/d1816-d1966-n12-first-en-author/lesson.template.json"))

errors.extend(flow_errors)
